breakdown.description: At the inlet, the specified phase volume fractions do not sum to 1 (e.g., alpha.air is set to 1.0 while alpha.catalyst is nonzero), which over-constrains the Euler–Euler phase fraction fields.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original request had phase volume fractions at the inlet that did not sum to 1. The generated specification explicitly sets the inlet air volume fraction to 0.99 and the catalyst volume fraction to 0.01. These values correctly sum to 1, resolving the over-constrained condition.
